title: DLRM shared embedding table with field-specific Mirror views
hypothesis: On MovieLens 100K binary preference prediction, a shared H=512 embedding table with eight field-wise 2D Givens angles per field will improve fresh logloss by at least 0.002 over the strongest byte-near shared-hash/diagonal control on both fresh training seeds, remain within 0.005 AUC of full DLRM tables, reduce complete serialized payload by at least 25% versus full tables, and add no more than 25% p95 lookup latency versus plain H=512 hashing.
task: Binary preference classification: explicit MovieLens rating >=4 is positive; ratings 1-3 are negative. This is not CTR prediction.
physical_object: One shared float32 table H[512,16] addressed by deterministic field-salted hashing, plus the common DLRM bottom/top MLP.
mirror_coordinate: Four field-specific coordinates, each containing eight scalar angles for non-overlapping Givens rotations over pairs (0,1),(2,3),...,(14,15); applied after shared-table lookup and before DLRM interactions.
logical_multiplicity: Four distinct field-conditioned embedding functions from one shared physical embedding table.

dataset.name: GroupLens MovieLens 100K
dataset.rating_source: ml-100k/ua.base for train/development; ml-100k/ua.test for fresh audit, never used for tuning
dataset.access_terms: Research use only; cite Harper and Konstan (2015); no redistribution; no commercial/revenue-bearing use without GroupLens permission. Archive is not committed.
dataset.citation: F. Maxwell Harper and Joseph A. Konstan. 2015. The MovieLens Datasets: History and Context. ACM TiiS 5(4), Article 19. DOI 10.1145/2827872.

model.interactions: pairwise dot products among four categorical vectors and one dense vector, concatenated with flattened vectors
model.dense_feature: UTC timestamp normalized using training-part mean/std; normalization state is serialized and counted
model.optimizer: Adam, lr=0.01, weight_decay=1e-6, batch=1024, CPU float32, one torch thread

data_split.development: Split ua.base by SHA256(user_id:movie_id); remainder train, hash modulo 10 equals 0 is development. Reject any duplicate pair crossing the split.
data_split.fresh: Official ua.test is the sole fresh audit; do not read numeric values until FRESH_FREEZE.json is committed.
data_split.feature_leakage: UTC month/weekday/timestamp are derived only from each observed rating event; no demographics, genres, global u.data, or future labels are used. Timestamp normalization is fit on the training partition only.

controls: Independent full-cardinality field tables (full DLRM control)
One shared H=128 field-salted hash table, no View
One shared H=512 field-salted hash table, no View
Four independent H=128 field hash tables (same total rows/bytes as shared H=512)
H=128 shared table + eight paired-diagonal gains per field (same code bytes as Mirror)
H=128 shared table + eight paired Givens angles per field
H=512 shared table + eight paired-diagonal gains per field (same code bytes as Mirror)
H=512 shared table + sixteen per-coordinate diagonal gains per field (stronger, twice-code-size diagonal control)
H=512 shared table + eight paired Givens angles per field

development.selection: Train each method to 8 epochs; choose epoch from {3,5,8} by mean dev logloss across both seeds. No audit labels or metrics enter selection.

fresh.training_data: All ua.base rows after development settings are frozen; each seed retrains from scratch.
fresh.audit_data: Official ua.test; evaluate once per seed.

paid_objects: all embedding tables or hash tables

success_gate: On both fresh seeds, H=512 Mirror logloss is <= the strongest of shared H=512 hash, H=512 paired diagonal, H=512 per-coordinate diagonal, and H=128x4 field tables minus 0.002; AUC is no more than 0.005 below full DLRM; complete payload is >=25% smaller than full DLRM; and lookup p95 is <=1.25x plain H=512 hash.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any registered quality/storage/latency gate, or any diagonal control matches its logloss within 0.002 on both seeds.
not_established_gate: Archive/hash mismatch, missing registered fields, audit overlap with development pairs, unreproducible required control, or runtime failure before all methods are evaluated.
boundaries: MovieLens 100K screen only; explicit preference is not CTR or production recommendation.
Official ua.test is opened only after fresh freeze and never used for tuning.
Two fresh seeds are initialization/training replicates on one fixed split, not independent datasets.
No capacity claim from fixed epochs; no broad recommender claim.
Do not redistribute the MovieLens archive or use it commercially.

amendments.reason: Pre-audit review found the first runner would persist audit binary labels alongside predictions, and the success comparator omitted the registered H=512 per-coordinate diagonal control. No ua.test numeric values were read.
amendments.change: Persist audit logits without row labels or IDs; metric verification will recover targets from the pinned archive. Add diag16_512 to the strongest-control gate. Keep model candidates, dev results, selected epochs, split, and seeds unchanged.
